question.text: What is the minimum threshold for computing the FBIL USD/INR reference rate?

answer.text: 10 transactions with aggregate amount of USD 25 million
50 transactions with aggregate amount of USD 100 million
5 transactions with aggregate amount of USD 10 million
20 transactions with aggregate amount of USD 50 million

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 26, a randomly selected 15-minute window between 11.30 and 12.30 must contain at least 10 transactions with an aggregate of USD 25 million. A +/- 3 standard deviation outlier rule is applied, and the volume-weighted average of surviving transactions is used. The Trap: Both conditions must be met simultaneously: the minimum transaction count AND the minimum aggregate value. Note: Pages 26-27 explain that if the criteria fail, random 15-minute windows can be repeated up to five times before falling back to the page-27 backup methodology.
